Frequently Asked Questions

items.q: What are facials for sensitive skin?
items.a: Facials for sensitive skin are gentle treatments designed to hydrate, soothe, and restore your skin’s natural barrier. At Elements Wellness, we use calming ingredients and techniques to reduce redness, inflammation and dryness caused by environmental factors like heat and pollution.

items.q: Are your facials safe for skin with rosacea or eczema?
items.a: Our facials are formulated with sensitive skin in mind, making them ideal for conditions like rosacea or eczema. However, we adopt a case-by-case approach as different people have different triggers.

items.q: How do facials for sensitive skin help with Singapore’s humidity?
items.a: In Singapore’s hot and humid climate, sensitive skin often struggles with moisture imbalance, redness, and irritation, the signs of a broken skin barrier. Our facials are specifically designed to hydrate deeply, soothe irritation, and strengthen the skin’s barrier against environmental stressors like heat and pollution.

items.q: How often should I get a facial for sensitive skin?
items.a: For optimal results, we recommend a facial every 4 weeks. However, the frequency can vary depending on your skin’s condition and concerns. Our skin therapists will tailor a treatment plan that works best for you.

items.q: Will I see immediate results from my facial?
items.a: Yes! Most clients notice a visible difference after just one facial, including smoother, more hydrated, and less irritated skin. For long-term benefits, consistent treatments can help maintain and enhance your skin’s health.

items.q: Can I wear makeup after my facial?
items.a: We recommend avoiding makeup for at least a few hours after your facial to allow your skin to fully absorb the calming and hydrating ingredients. Your skin will feel refreshed, but it’s best to give it time to breathe.

items.q: How do I know which facial is right for my skin?
items.a: Our experienced skin therapists will assess your skin during a consultation and recommend the best facial treatment based on your unique needs—whether you’re dealing with dryness, irritation, or an imbalanced skin barrier.

items.q: What type of cleanser is best for sensitive skin?
items.a: For sensitive skin, it’s important to use a gentle, hydrating cleanser that won’t strip or irritate your skin. Look for cream or milk-based cleansers, hydrating gel cleansers, or micellar water. These types of cleansers are typically mild and help preserve the skin’s natural moisture while removing impurities. Avoid cleansers with strong fragrances or harsh exfoliants, as these can cause irritation.
